wireframes.desktop: Skip links, product, place with origin and Change place, as-of date, language, full-width search, This place or Search worldwide, searched and remaining counts, status. Then a side column with Laws and sources for this place and collapsed Filters, beside one ranked result list. Reader or preview keeps the list. Map and model stay closed.
wireframes.mobile: Sticky header with place, origin, Change place, as-of date, language, and search. Scope and counts follow. Results stack in one column. Filters open in a sheet. A result opens a reader with Back to results and restores scroll. Map and model stay closed.

landmarks.live: polite atomic status, visually hidden, not display none

steps: Tab reaches Skip to search. Enter focuses the search field.
Shift+Tab from search reaches Language, As of, Change place, and the place combobox.
ArrowDown opens the place list. ArrowUp and ArrowDown move. Enter selects. Escape closes the list and leaves the place unchanged.
A country row does not select a city. Duplicate names stay unselected until one parent chain is chosen.
As of changes the civil date only. Language changes the interface locale only.
Enter in the search field submits. An empty query remains no-query.
This place and Search worldwide are radios. Arrow keys move between them.
Suggestions open under the field that produced them.
Enter accepts the active row. Escape dismisses the list.
A query that names another place proposes a change and does not replace the current place.
Ambiguous names and border candidates pre-select no row.
Skip to filters focuses the Filters summary. Enter or Space opens it.
Desktop expands the controls in the column. Mobile opens a dialog sheet and moves focus to its heading.
Tab moves through level, place, topic, instrument type, language, source, and date/status.
Mobile Tab stays in the sheet. Escape or Close filters restores focus to the Filters control.
Skip to results focuses the result list. Result titles are links. Enter opens the reader.
On mobile, Back to results is first in the reader and restores focus and scroll.
A place, date, or scope change announces place, origin, date, scope, and coverage once in the polite live region.
A cancelled or stale response does not move focus and does not rewrite the list.

states.next_action: Choose a place or search worldwide.
states.summary: The place is unselected worldwide. Search is focused. No result is invented.
states.announcement: Worldwide laws. No place is selected. Choose a place or search worldwide.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage is not a result until a place or a worldwide search is chosen.

states.next_action: Change place if this approximate suggestion is wrong, or search this place.
states.summary: An approximate IP suggestion is visible. Search text is not sent to the provider. Consent can require an explicit request first.
states.announcement: Approximate place suggestion. Change place if it is wrong.
states.coverage_copy: A country-only suggestion does not choose a city.

states.next_action: Choose a country, region, or municipality.
states.summary: The approximate lookup failed, timed out, or was opted out. The current place stays.
states.announcement: Approximate location is unavailable. Choose a country, region, or municipality.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage is unchanged.

states.next_action: Location permission was denied. Choose a country, region, or municipality.
states.summary: Device permission was denied or has not been requested. Coordinates are not shown or stored.
states.announcement: Location permission was denied. Choose a country, region, or municipality.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage is unchanged.

states.next_action: Choose one place. Duplicate names stay unselected until you do.
states.summary: Rows that share a name show different parent chains. None is selected yet.
states.visible_copy: More than one place has this name.
states.announcement: More than one place has this name. Choose one place.
states.coverage_copy: No coverage cell is selected until one place is chosen.

states.next_action: Search this place, or change it.
states.summary: The visitor selected a place. A late suggestion cannot replace it.
states.announcement: Place changed. The place was manually selected.
states.coverage_copy: Laws and sources for this place

states.next_action: Choose the jurisdiction that matches your question.
states.summary: More than one jurisdiction matches a border or overlap. The uncertainty stays visible and no city is invented.
states.visible_copy: More than one jurisdiction matches. No place was selected.
states.announcement: Border uncertainty. Choose the jurisdiction that matches your question.
states.scope_copy: The current scope is unchanged until a candidate is chosen.
states.coverage_copy: Candidate jurisdictions are listed. Inclusion is not claimed.

states.next_action: Enter a question, citation, or identifier, then search.
states.summary: The query is empty. The page does not treat that as a statement about the law.
states.visible_copy: Enter a question, citation, or identifier.
states.announcement: No query. Enter a question, citation, or identifier, then search.
states.coverage_copy: An empty search is not a result about the law.

states.next_action: Revise the query, clear a filter, or open coverage for this place.
states.summary: The collections that were searched returned no rows. Unsearched collections stay named.
states.visible_copy: No matches in the collections that were searched.
states.announcement: No matches in the collections that were searched.
states.coverage_copy: No matches is not a finding that no law exists.

states.next_action: Continue the search, or open the unsearched collection on the coverage page.
states.summary: A known collection was not searched. The remaining count includes it.
states.announcement: A collection was not searched. Continue the search or open coverage.
states.coverage_copy: This is not all worldwide results.

states.next_action: Read the national and regional sources, and open the municipal coverage gap.
states.summary: The place is searchable. The municipal cell has no catalog collection. National and regional sources can still appear.
states.visible_copy: No municipal collection is in the catalog for this place.
states.announcement: Municipal coverage is missing from the catalog. That is not a finding that no local law exists.
states.coverage_copy: No municipal collection is in the catalog for this place. That is a coverage gap, not a finding that no local law exists.

states.next_action: Read the results already shown, or continue loading the remaining shards.
states.summary: Retrieved results stay on screen with searched and remaining counts.
states.announcement: Partial results. Some collections remain.
states.coverage_copy: These are the results retrieved so far. This is not all worldwide results.

states.next_action: Start a new search. The cancelled results stay off the page.
states.summary: The in-flight query was cancelled. A late response cannot paint over a newer search.
states.announcement: The search was cancelled. Start a new search.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage is unchanged.

states.next_action: Retry the source, or read saved material when a copy is on this device.
states.summary: A source is throttling or unavailable. Any saved copy keeps its revision label.
states.visible_copy: This source is unavailable right now.
states.announcement: A source is unavailable. Retry, or read saved material.
states.coverage_copy: Collection unavailable

states.next_action: Refresh this source, or keep reading the saved copy with its revision visible.
states.summary: The cached revision differs from the catalog revision. Both are visible.
states.visible_copy: This saved copy is older than the catalog revision.
states.announcement: Stale saved copy. The catalog has a newer revision.
states.coverage_copy: Partial collection

states.next_action: Read the saved material, or reconnect to search sources that are not on this device.
states.summary: The device is offline. Only public material already saved on the device is offered.
states.announcement: Offline. Saved material is available. Other sources are not on this device.
states.coverage_copy: Sources that are not saved on this device are unavailable.

states.next_action: Continue with ordinary search. A model download stays optional.
states.summary: No model, GPU, or model network is required. Lexical search remains the primary path.
states.visible_copy: A model is unavailable. Search does not need one.
states.announcement: A model is unavailable. Ordinary search is available.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage does not depend on a model.

states.next_action: Open the source record, or search a source whose status is known.
states.summary: Issuer, date, or status that the record does not provide is labelled unknown.
states.announcement: Source or status is unknown.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage unknown

states.next_action: Read the original text, or keep the labelled translation beside it.
states.summary: The original title stays. A translation is labelled machine translation or official translation.
states.announcement: A labelled translation is shown beside the original text.
states.coverage_copy: The translation is not a new source revision.

states.next_action: Set the as-of date, or open the version that matches it.
states.summary: The version is historical text or future commencement, with the source date precision.
states.announcement: This text is historical or not yet commenced. Check the as-of date.
states.coverage_copy: The version label is not a claim that the text is current.

states.next_action: Correct the link, or continue with the place and date already on the page.
states.summary: A route parameter is invalid. The place and date already on the page are kept.
states.visible_copy: This link has a parameter that could not be read.
states.announcement: The link could not be read. The current place and date are unchanged.
states.coverage_copy: Coverage is unchanged.

states.next_action: Review the announced place, date, and coverage, then search or change place.
states.summary: A place, date, or scope change is shown in the header and spoken once by the polite live region.
states.visible_copy: Laws and sources for this place
states.announcement: Scope changed. Review the place, date, and coverage.
states.coverage_copy: Laws and sources for this place
